use_when: Web code that takes requests, builds queries, renders output, fetches URLs, deserializes data, handles sessions or accepts files is being written or reviewed, or an app needs a sweep for the recurring vulnerability classes.
not_for: Design-stage boundary and asset work (threat-modeling), the reading order and reporting discipline of a review pass (secure-code-review), infrastructure and network hardening, or reciting a compliance list without reading code.
